text:
maria: Heads-up  weve opened a small, controlled HU250 (Hopper Ultra 250) Dedicated burst pool in ap-south1 (Mumbai) and eu-west3 (Paris) as of 2026-06-17 09:00 PT. This is a cautious ramp focused on inference serving latency improvements.

kevin: Setup details: 6 HU250 GPUs per zone, 2 zones per region. Burst windows: 04:00-20:00 local. These are non-guaranteed burst nodes and may be preempted for higher-tier reserved capacity.

ops-bot: provisioning job #prov-5022 -> SUCCESS :white_check_mark: (hu250 pools in ap-south1/eu-west3)

maria: Policy highlight: to ensure fair access during ramp, were enforcing a per-org rolling 24h cap of 50 GPU-hours across hu250 burst pools. Please design fallbacks.

kevin: NOTE  reservation guidance: if customers need sustained capacity, recommend filing a Dedicated reservation request. Burst is for short-term headroom only. cc @dena for commercial follow-up.

dena: Billing note: burst usage will appear under billing code "dedicated.burst.hu250". AMs will be notified for accounts breaching the cap; we'll offer migration plans to reserved capacity.

alec: Telemetry: added metrics preemption_count, pool_variant, and per_request_pool_id to the Console. If product teams see preemption >7% for a route, escalate to infra.

sre-oncall: We'll run a staged smoke test Monday 06:30 PT to validate routing/fallback. Expect transient increased error rates (~3-7 minutes) during the test.

maria: Ops checklist for teams: 1) enable region fallback and model-variant fallback; 2) add request-level priority where possible; 3) add retry/backoff in client. Example config snippet:
```
routing:
  pool_preference: ["ap-south1:hu250", "eu-west3:hu250"]
  fallbacks: ["mi300-medium", "a100x-small"]
  priority: user
```

kevin: Quick CLI for testing (non-prod only):
```
redwood reserved-reserve --pool hu250 --region ap-south1 --count 1 --duration 1h
redwood infer --model gpt-large --pool hu250 --region ap-south1 --priority low
```

maria: Action items: product teams validate fallback flows in staging by Thursday EOD. Solutions/sales send any immediate reservation requests to @dena. Eng infra monitor preemption, egress, and model QoS.

dena: Docs PR will land today with UI labeling, billing examples, and migration steps.

maria: Thanks all  this is a conservative rollout to iron out region-specific edge cases. Ping me or @kevin for urgent issues. :rocket:
